title: ICSI Announces Empanelment of General Observers for CSEET October 2026 Session
content:
# ICSI Announces Empanelment of General Observers for CSEET October 2026 Session

Ek important update hai. The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne Company Secretary Executive Entrance Test (CSEET) October 2026 Session ke liye General Observers (GO) ke empanelment ki ghoshna ki hai.

Eligible members ko CSEET October 2026 exams ke smooth conduct ko ensure karne ke liye General Observers ke roop mein depute kiya jayega.

*   **Application Period:** Empanelment ke liye applications ICSI Observer Portal par 10 August 2026 se 31 August 2026 tak online mode mein available rahenge.
*   **CSEET Exam Dates:** October 2026 session ke liye CSEET examinations 1 October 2026 se 6 October 2026 tak conduct ki jayengi.
*   **Eligibility Criteria:**
    *   Applicant ICSI ka member hona chahiye aur koi bhi relative CSEET October 2026 mein appear na ho.
    *   Applicant ki age 25 se 65 saal ke beech honi chahiye aur membership 3 saal se purani honi chahiye without any break.
    *   Koi bhi trainee CSEET October 2026 mein appear na ho, aur applicant khud ICSI ke kisi examination mein appear na ho.
    *   Applicant Institute ki Council / Regional Council / Managing Committee of Chapter(s) se associated nahi hona chahiye, na hi oral tuition classes ya private coaching center se.
    *   Applicant ke against koi disciplinary/criminal proceedings pending nahi honi chahiye.
*   **Honorarium:** General Observer duty ke liye Rs. 1,400 per day ka honorarium provide kiya jayega.
